text:
maria_g: Heads-up — Acme deal negotiation tomorrow. They want 99.95% latency SLA for reserved pool and a burst capacity clause. Need quick alignment on what we're willing to promise and rollback options.

alex_k: 99.95 at p95 for text-gen on 8k context is tight. We can promise 99.95 for p99 if we require warm pool + hot spare. Otherwise 99.9 realistic.

sam_r: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- SLA target pinned to model version and quantization profile
- Warm pool size >= 2x expected concurrency
- Canary pass (no >2% error rate) for 24h
- Automated fallback to smaller model on sustained latency

jen_l: Edge cases to call out: KV cache coldstarts, burst from scheduled jobs, region failover with cross-region routing delays, customer-side retries causing apparent spikes.

riley_ops: Ops playbook draft:
1) Detect sustained p95 > SLO for 5m
2) Scale warm pool by +20% (if spare capacity available)
3) If scaling fails, switch routing to fallback-model v2-quant
4) Notify AM + customer with incident template
5) Temporary throttle low-priority routes
6) Postmortem and credit if SLA breached > agreed window

riley_ops: Example autoscale snippet for the runbook:
```
thresholds:
  p95_latency_ms: 300
  scale_step: 20%  # add to warm pool
  cooldown: 300s
fallback:
  model: redwood-gen-medium-q4
  reason: "failed_scale_or_capacity_exhaustion"
```

alex_k: Important: fallback model must be validated for functional parity on core prompts. Add a quick eval set run during canary.

sam_r: Suggest adding 'commit-exception' clause to contract: allow N hours for capacity fill during initial ramp; define acceptable burst degradation (e.g., degrade to 60% throughput for up to 4h) — keeps us honest.

jen_l: Also include privacy/KMS note for Private deployments: SLA only applies to Redwood-managed control plane; on-prem customers require separate agreement.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for reserved-pool-acme finished: 6h, errors 0.8%, p95=290ms. :party:

maria_g: Nice. With that canary we can offer 99.95 with warm pool + ramp clause. Action items:
- maria_g update PRD + contract redlines (due Fri)
- alex_k add fallback-model eval + perf matrix
- riley_ops finalize runbook + escalation flow
- sam_r draft commit-exception wording

maria_g: Quick vote: thumbs up to proceed to legal with these constraints? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

alex_k: :thumbsup:

sam_r: :thumbsup:

jen_l: :thumbsup:

riley_ops: :thumbsup:

maria_g: Great — moving forward. I'll post PRD link when updated.
